threshold_basis: 1 kPa is a published simulation start, not a measured full initial state. 5 and 10 kPa are analyst-selected development sensitivity scenarios, not independently justified admission thresholds.
selection: First measured observation at or above threshold on the original first-loading branch; no interpolation. End before the first strictly decreasing axial-stress step; retain repeated controls. This data-only diagnostic does not discard observations from normalized records.

source_evidence.established: Simulations start at 1 kPa axial stress; IGS is assumed fully mobilized in the vertical direction. The four displayed oedometer tests supplied hs, n and beta calibration information.
source_evidence.not_established: The reviewed passage does not specify initial lateral stress; source IGS initialization does not apply to a base law without that state.

source_evidence.established: The comparison again starts oedometer simulations at 1 kPa axial stress and assumes vertically mobilized intergranular strain for hypoplastic/ISA models; first-loading curves were calibration evidence.
source_evidence.not_established: This is not a complete initialization recipe for the current base-law adapter or independent validation of those first-loading curves.

source_evidence.established: The residual imposes 1+e_new=(1+e_old)*exp(-trace(de)) for a prescribed increment.
source_evidence.not_established: This analytical continuity diagnostic does not run or verify stress integration and does not change the declared infinitesimal/zero-spin constitutive scope.

source_evidence.established: The rate is de/ds=-(1+e)*trace(D); its exact integral has exponential continuity for the imposed accumulated strain coordinate.
source_evidence.not_established: This analytical continuity diagnostic does not run or verify stress integration and does not change the declared infinitesimal/zero-spin constitutive scope.

open_decisions: Supply and justify full initial stress, including lateral stress, without describing an assumed K0 as measured.

Choose and qualify the loading coordinate. Engineering increments in the native exponential void-ratio continuity law differ from constant-solid-volume geometry. A logarithmic height coordinate restores that geometry but is not itself a finite-strain extension of the stress law.
Review dry-test effective-stress interpretation and material-point applicability.

Keep zero-stress unloading/reloading outside a positive-pressure replay until an explicit admissible path and history policy exist; do not independently restart reloading and call it a continuous cycle.
Declare objective channels and weighting without counting linked strain and void ratio as independent measurements.
Run initialization/coordinate sensitivity and numerical refinement before adding compression to common-information calibration.
